paragraphs: The block diagram for the Plant Watering Reminder Using STM32 And Soil Moisture Sensor is presented below. This diagram illustrates the functional flow of the system, from the input sensor to the output notification.

The system consists of an STM32 Blue Pill microcontroller, which acts as the central processing unit (CPU) and memory manager. The microcontroller is connected to a soil moisture sensor through a GPIO pin, which reads the moisture level in the plant's soil.

Once the moisture level is detected by the sensor, it is processed by the microcontroller using an algorithm that determines whether the plant needs water or not. If the plant does not need water, the system outputs a notification to the user indicating that the plant is healthy and no watering is required.

The block diagram also includes a power supply for the STM32 Blue Pill and the soil moisture sensor, as well as a display device for showing the notification to the user. The display device can be connected to an external monitor or a built-in OLED screen on the STM32 Blue Pill.
